info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Petadoption Pets Details-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Details API provides comprehensive information about pets available for adoption. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve specific details such as breed, age, and temperament of pets to facilitate informed adoption decisions. It is particularly useful for animal shelters, adoption agencies, and prospective pet owners seeking to learn about adoptable pets. By accessing this information, users can make better choices and contribute to successful pet adoptions.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific pet.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed information about a specific pet, including its characteristics, health status, and owner details. It's essential for ensuring comprehensive understanding and care for pet needs.
